Name: Primary Phone
Description: Patient's primary contact phone number; added 2026-10-05 to match live ACT registry's Patient Information phone grid -- registration form supports only one phone number, not live's repeating grid of multiple numbers

Name: Phone Owner
Description: Name of the person who owns the primary phone; often a family member, not the patient; wired to the registration form's rhd-registration section 2026-10-05 to match live ACT registry's Patient Information phone fields (single phone number, not live's repeating grid)

Name: Phone Owner Relationship
Description: Relationship of the phone owner to the patient (Mother, Father, Patient / Self, ...); wired to the registration form's rhd-registration section 2026-10-05 to match live ACT registry's Patient Information phone fields (single phone number, not live's repeating grid)

Name: WhatsApp Available
Description: Whether the primary phone can receive WhatsApp messages; wired to the registration form's rhd-registration section 2026-10-05 to match live ACT registry's Patient Information phone fields (single phone number, not live's repeating grid); changed from Boolean to Concept format 2026-10-06, matching Consent Given/Text-It Settings exactly -- the registration app's PersonAttributeField renders Boolean format as a plain checkbox, not the Yes/No selector live uses; stores the standard Yes/No concepts directly via customConceptAnswers in the registration config, no dedicated answer-set concept needed

Name: Telegram Available
Description: Whether the primary phone can receive Telegram messages; wired to the registration form's rhd-registration section 2026-10-05 to match live ACT registry's Patient Information phone fields (single phone number, not live's repeating grid); changed from Boolean to Concept format 2026-10-06, matching Consent Given/Text-It Settings exactly -- the registration app's PersonAttributeField renders Boolean format as a plain checkbox, not the Yes/No selector live uses; stores the standard Yes/No concepts directly via customConceptAnswers in the registration config, no dedicated answer-set concept needed

Name: Consent Given
Description: Whether registry consent was given -- Concept format 2026-09-21, backed by the coded Consent Given concept (0f17c1a8-074a-581c-9a16-647315bbb12e) with a Yes/No answer set, so the value is a real coded answer rather than a free-typed string

Name: Consent Date
Description: Date registry consent was recorded -- String format (not java.util.Date) 2026-09-21 because the patient registration app's PersonAttributeField only handles String/Concept/Location formats, not Date

Name: Consent Person
Description: Person who gave consent, if not the patient

Name: School
Description: School attended, where the patient is a child

Name: Assigned Cardiac Clinic
Description: Cardiac clinic the patient is assigned to for RHD follow-up care; found on live ACT registry's Create a Patient screen 2026-09-21, missing locally -- Location format so the registration screen's location picker resolves to a real Location reference, not a free-typed string; moved off the RHD Patient Information AMPATH form 2026-09-21 onto patient registration since esm-form-engine-lib's personAttribute adapter has a FHIR-extension-URL mismatch bug that prevents saved values from ever pre-filling on reopen

Name: Text-It Settings
Description: Whether the patient is opted in to Text-It SMS reminders; found on live ACT registry's Create a Patient screen 2026-09-21, missing locally -- Concept format (not java.lang.Boolean) 2026-09-21, backed by the coded Text-It Settings Opt-In concept (3b3bccf8-5bf9-5cce-94a8-480c6695c14b) with a Yes/No answer set, because the patient registration app's PersonAttributeField only handles String/Concept/Location formats, not Boolean, and Concept format itself requires a Coded-datatype concept with a real answer list to render

Name: Primary Care Clinic
Description: Community clinic for patient, found on live ACT registry's Patient Information form 2026-10-05, missing locally -- Location format, same pattern as Assigned Cardiac Clinic, so the registration screen's location picker resolves to a real Location reference; placed on patient registration rather than the RHD Patient Information AMPATH form for the same esm-form-engine-lib personAttribute pre-fill bug reason as Assigned Cardiac Clinic
